name: io.github.stacklok/edusign
title: Edusign
description: Edusign's official remote MCP server for attendance, learners, courses, documents, and API guidance

https://mcp.edusign.com.overview: Edusign provides a hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server for working with Edusign attendance, learners, courses, documents, and API guidance. Connect to https://mcp.edusign.com using OAuth 2.1; access follows each Edusign user's permissions. See https://developers.edusign.com/docs/mcp for setup and available capabilities.
